web_checks.description: A question arising while reading a paper grows through investigation, calculation, writing and review into an explanation. At the ATRL atelier, an agentic editorial team and an agentic development and operations team work under human direction, revising how roles and tools connect as findings and feedback return. This essay follows how designing and examining that collaborative structure becomes part of research and creative practice.
